none: PAS CAM-096345: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG] ; R/ [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]

A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, 364-375. Mint is possibly Lyons or Aquileia, Reece period 19. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads [D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Reverse legend reads [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...].
